R452.note: Adds secure: true to the existing res.cookie options; nothing else changes and the change is stated.

R453.note: Moves label and status into a constant Jinja2 template via render_template_string so both are autoescaped; banner markup and defaults are unchanged.

R454.note: Pins ValidAlgorithms to HS256 matching the symmetric key, which is the restriction the finding asks for and is stated; the write-up assumes the issuer signs HS256 rather than confirming it.

R455.note: Rejects field_index >= MAX_FIELDS with the existing -1 error path before the array read; valid indices behave exactly as before.

R456.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare gives exact, length-sensitive equality and the empty-header guard is kept, so the contract holds.

R457.note: URI.isAbsolute() is false for a scheme-relative value such as //evil.com/x, which the container resolves to an external redirect, so the open redirect is only partially closed; the relative-only restriction is stated.

R458.note: archive/tar removes the shell entirely, but ctx is now ignored (contract requires request-context cancellation) and compressed archives that tar -tf auto-detected now return 500; neither is stated.

R459.note: shared_ptr ownership closes the UAF and the subscribe signature change is stated, but with no unsubscribe path every observer is now kept alive and dispatched to forever (one leaked per monitorOnce call), and the write-up's claim that objects die once the bus removes them is untrue since no removal exists.

R460.note: redis-py encodes field and value via length-prefixed RESP so CRLF cannot split commands; the new dependency is named, and the only unstated nuance is that reads are no longer bounded by the original 2s socket timeout.

R461.note: Unseeded SecureRandom replaces Random(seed); the seed parameter parsing and token format are unchanged.

R462.note: 16 bytes from SecureRandom, base64url-encoded, replaces Math.random(); the cookie value format change is stated and uses only cookie-safe characters.

R463.note: subprocess.run with an argument list and stdout/stderr redirected to the log file reproduces the original capture without a shell; a host beginning with - could still be read as a ping option since no -- separator is used.

R464.note: self.get_object() applies the owner-scoped queryset (404 for others' invoices) and IsInvoiceOwner, with the response body unchanged.

R465.note: Build fails: Order has getCustomerUsername() not getUserId() and CustomUserDetails does not exist, so the service no longer compiles and the ownership check is written against a field the model does not have.

R466.note: sqlite3 ? placeholder with (term,) binds the value as data; query semantics for legitimate names are unchanged.
